2. The Famous One: Dogecoin ($DOGE)
In 2013, two software engineers, Billy Markus and Jackson Palmer, created $DOGE as a parody of Bitcoin. It was based on the popular Shiba Inu “Doge” meme and was never meant to be taken seriously.
